svg.title: vgacap overview
svg.desc: A Tiny Tapeout demo board's uo_out is captured by the board's own RP2040 or RP2350 (PIO, DMA, USB to ttcap), either straight from the design's breakout or as framed bytes from capture logic beside the design on an iCE40UP5K FPGA breakout; or a simulator runs the design's RTL. All write one vgacap stream, which libvgaframe turns into pictures, video and pixel-exact checks.
